user: Give me reason code for transaction TX-0401 with amount 240.00 EUR.
answer:
I can't tell from the request alone which reason code fits TX-0401, because the code depends on what went wrong with the payment. Verta's dispute reason codes and their windows (days from the transaction date) are:

| Reason code | Use when | Window (days) |
|---|---|---|
| duplicate_charge | The same payment was charged more than once | 60 |
| fraud_card_not_present | A card payment was made without your authorization (online or phone) | 120 |
| goods_not_received | You paid for goods that were never delivered | 90 |
| service_not_rendered | You paid for a service that was not provided | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | A debit was taken from your account without your authorization | 56 |

If you tell me what happened with the EUR 240.00 payment, I can suggest the matching code. I can also check whether TX-0401 is eligible under that code. If you're not sure which applies, I can search the dispute rules for more detail.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Notifications
## Dispute updates
A dispute generates a notification on every state change. The notification
names the state, never the internal reason for a decision.
